definitions.explanation: A savory Japanese pancake containing various ingredients such as cabbage, meat, and seafood, cooked on a griddle and topped with sauce, mayonnaise, and bonito flakes.

examples.japanese: お{好|この}み{焼|や}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{好|この}み{焼|や}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
お{好|この}み{焼|や}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦マヨネーズ→マヨネーズ：11129_mayoneezu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Put mayonnaise and sauce on the okonomiyaki.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From お⟦{好|この}み→好み：02767_konomi⟧ (as you like) + ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (grilled/fried), meaning "grilled as you like it" because customers can choose their toppings.

REGIONAL STYLES:
- ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧{風|ふう}: ingredients mixed into batter
- ⟦{広島|ひろしま}→広島：28985_hiroshima⟧{風|ふう}: layered style with noodles

COMMON TOPPINGS:
- ⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧: okonomiyaki sauce
- ⟦マヨネーズ→マヨネーズ：11129_mayoneezu⟧: mayonnaise
- ⟦{鰹節|かつおぶし}→鰹節：04935_katsuobushi⟧: bonito flakes
- {青|あお}のり: green laver seaweed
